set.body:
Source: PRD.html sections 17, 19, 20, and 21.

Scope:
- Audit every PRD functional and quality requirement against live code, tests, documentation, and real-site receipts.
- Stabilize public ADTs and algebras, persistence/wire migrations, compatibility policy, security posture, and module dependency boundaries.
- Complete API examples for local opaque scripts, remote opaque scripts, declared outputs, resumable logs, managed recovery, and typed Scala results.
- Run deterministic fault laws, local/SSH differential suites, disposable-cluster tests, supported-version fixture tests, and real-site acceptance.
- Document known limitations and release/upgrade procedures without overclaiming exactly-once execution, live log availability, accounting access, or retry safety.

Acceptance:
- All PRD v1 acceptance criteria have concrete evidence.
- Every public interpreter passes the shared conformance suite.
- No unbounded queue, subprocess capture, log page, or log line remains.
- mote doctor is clean, all required child slices are closed, and the epic closes only after a requirement-by-requirement evidence audit.
set.title: P6: Harden and certify the scala-slurm v1 contract
